Although the company is currently operating with strong gross (74%) and operating (46%) margins, the massive overhang of liabilities exceeding total assets by nearly $2 billion puts the issuer at imminent risk of insolvency or restructuring. This profile of highly vulnerable liquidity and negative net worth aligns with a deeply speculative, high-default-risk rating.

DECISION: CCC-
